# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Unclear how Spotify API encodes genre strings (exact 'reggae' vs 'Reggae'); will use case-insensitive substring check after inspecting results.</uncertainty>

access_token = spotify_access_token

# 1) Fetch all playlists in library (paged)
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlists page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total playlists', len(all_playlists))

# Collect unique song IDs across all playlists
all_song_ids = set()
for pl in all_playlists:
    for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
        all_song_ids.add(sid)

print('unique song_ids', len(all_song_ids))

# 2) Determine reggae songs by inspecting each song's genre
reggae_song_ids = []
reggae_artists = {}  # artist_id -> name

for i, sid in enumerate(sorted(all_song_ids)):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(sid)
    genre = song.get('genre', '')
    if genre is None:
        genre = ''
    genre_norm = str(genre).lower()
    if 'reggae' in genre_norm:
        reggae_song_ids.append(sid)
        for a in song.get('artists', []):
            aid = a.get('id')
            aname = a.get('name')
            if aid is not None:
                reggae_artists[aid] = aname
    if (i+1) % 10 == 0:
        print('processed', i+1, '/', len(all_song_ids))

print('reggae_song_ids count', len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae artists unique', len(reggae_artists))
print('sample reggae artists', list(reggae_artists.items())[:10])

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy
# <uncertainty>Assuming song['genre'] contains the genre name (e.g., 'Reggae') for filtering.

access_token = spotify_access_token

# Reuse all_playlists and all_song_ids computed earlier if present; otherwise recompute quickly
if 'all_playlists' not in globals() or not all_playlists:
    all_playlists = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('playlists page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        all_playlists.extend(page)
        page_index += 1

all_song_ids = set()
for pl in all_playlists:
    for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
        all_song_ids.add(sid)

print('unique song_ids', len(all_song_ids))

reggae_song_ids = []
reggae_artist_ids = set()
reggae_artist_id_to_name = {}

# Also collect reggae song -> artists
reggae_song_artists = {}

song_ids_sorted = sorted(all_song_ids)
for idx, sid in enumerate(song_ids_sorted):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre_norm = str(song.get('genre','')).lower() if song.get('genre', None) is not None else ''
    is_reggae = 'reggae' in genre_norm
    if is_reggae:
        reggae_song_ids.append(sid)
        artists = song.get('artists', [])
        artist_ids = []
        for a in artists:
            aid = a.get('id')
            aname = a.get('name')
            if aid is not None:
                reggae_artist_ids.add(aid)
                reggae_artist_id_to_name[aid] = aname
                artist_ids.append(aid)
        reggae_song_artists[sid] = artist_ids
    if (idx+1) % 10 == 0:
        print('processed', idx+1, '/', len(song_ids_sorted))

print('reggae_song_ids count', len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_artist_ids count', len(reggae_artist_ids))
print('reggae artists (id,name) sample', list(reggae_artist_id_to_name.items())[:15])
print('reggae songs sample', reggae_song_ids[:10])
